notes:
Summary: large contact center (1500+ agents global). Primary use case = agent assist + automated summarization of new tickets. Key constraints: must provide verifiable citations in agent UI, support multi-source retrieval (Zendesk/Confluence/S3/SQL), and maintain sub-300ms median latency for quick reply suggestions during peak hours.

Key quotes / call notes:
- 'We need a chain-of-trust for answers — source + snippet + timestamp, otherwise legal won't allow automation.' — Head of CX Ops
- 'If the system hallucinated even 1% of the time it will be pulled from pilots.' — Lead ML Eng

Technical asks / POC success criteria (customer-provided):
- Citation accuracy >= 90% (link-level) on sampled queries
- Freshness window: new KB entries should be available in RAG within 30 minutes of ingestion
- Latency: 95th percentile < 600ms for top-k retrieval + generation in agent UI at 1000 concurrent agents
- Fail-open policy: graceful fallback to short answers + link to KB when heavy load or model fallback used

Current implementation notes:
- Using hybrid index (dense + BM25) recommended; customer testing with Elastic + Milvus prototype.
- Chunking strategy: 600 token overlaps for long Confluence pages caused noisy citations; SE recommends passage-level chunking + hit-rerank.
- Suggested Redwood configuration: Dedicated GPU pool for peak windows, autoscale with pre-warming, KV-prefix cache for repeated agent contexts, and per-route citation policies.

Open items and blockers:
- Legal needs explicit retention controls and guaranteed audit trail for RAG citations (drive doc shared).
- Security wants KMS-backed key rotation + ability to air-gap on premise for EMEA PII workloads.
- Cost sensitivity: wants a proposal showing unit cost per agent suggestion at 100k queries/mo vs caching/batching optimizations.
